title: Customer Service Executive (Community & Guest Support)
description:
About Us

We are The Keystone (www.thekeystone.sg), a coliving and student accommodation brand based in Singapore, managed by Homestead Capital Pte Ltd. We manage properties across five locations in Singapore and are growing. We are looking for two Customer Service Executives to join our remote team and take care of our residents and guests across every messaging channel.



The Role

You will be the voice of The Keystone to our residents and guests. Our team in Singapore handles everything on the ground; you own the conversations. This means answering questions, resolving problems, following up until issues are properly closed, and making people feel looked after. Our residents are mostly international postgraduate students, alongside short-stay guests who book through online travel platforms.



This role suits someone who writes well, stays calm when a message arrives angry, and takes ownership without being chased. Since we are based in Singapore, working hours will be based on Singapore Standard Time (SGT).



Key Responsibilities

WhatsApp Management: Respond to residents and guests on WhatsApp, including our property community groups, with a warm and professional tone.

OTA Platform Messages: Manage guest messages on 
, Airbnb and similar platforms, responding promptly and within platform response-time targets.

Inbox Management: Monitor, organize and promptly respond to enquiries in our shared email inboxes.

Complaint Handling: Log every complaint with property, unit, category and severity. Route to the correct team in Singapore, follow up until resolved, and confirm satisfaction with the resident.

Escalation: Identify urgent issues immediately and escalate them according to our written escalation procedures.

Move-In and Move-Out Coordination: Confirm dates, send instructions, collect required documents, and keep schedules accurate.

Renewal Outreach: Contact students whose agreements are expiring, record their intentions, and hand warm leads to our Sales team.

Administrative Support: Process visitor registrations, update our property management system, facility bookings, and keep tracking spreadsheets meticulously updated.

Reporting: Prepare a daily handover summary and weekly reports on message volumes, common issues and outstanding items.



Requirements

Excellent written English with professional messaging etiquette. This is the single most important requirement, as almost all of your work is written.

Strong spoken English for occasional calls.

Genuine patience and empathy. Some messages arrive angry and at inconvenient times, and we need someone who calms a situation rather than matching its tone.

High level of attention to detail, particularly in logging issues and updating records accurately.

Ability to work independently, manage your time, and own a problem end to end in a remote environment.

Proficiency in Google Workspace (especially Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office.

Reliable computer, stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, backup power or a backup working location, and a quiet place to work.

Available to work during Singapore hours (SGT).



We welcome both junior and experienced applicants. If you are early in your career but have excellent written English and a real service mindset, please apply. Experience in customer service, guest relations, hospitality or property management is an advantage but not a requirement.



Advantageous Experience

Experience with OTA extranets (
, Airbnb, Agoda).

Experience with a Property Management System (we use TheHouseMonk; similar systems count).

Experience with WhatsApp Business.

Background in student accommodation, coliving, hotels or serviced apartments.

Comfortable using AI tools to draft and check your work. We use them daily and will train you.



Working Hours

This is a full-time role of 44 hours per week, aligned to Singapore Standard Time (SGT). Singapore and the Philippines share the same time zone, so every shift falls within normal waking hours. There is no overnight shift.



Both positions are rostered. Shifts fall between 8:00am and 10:00pm SGT, and you may be scheduled on either daytime or evening shifts depending on the week. Our residents and guests are most active on weekends, so weekend shifts form part of the rotation, with rest days falling on weekdays in return.



Confidentiality

You will handle resident personal information. You will be asked to sign a confidentiality and data protection agreement before starting, and to follow our data handling rules. We take this seriously and so must you.



How to Apply

Please send your updated resume and a brief cover letter explaining your experience with customer communication and administrative tasks.



To ensure you have read this entire post, please include the phrase "Keystone Customer Service Executive Application" in the subject line of your application.

description:

The role is to manage and optimize the accounts payable / receivable process, ensuring timely invoice processing and maintaining accurate financial records in Excel, Xero and Cargowise.  High attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. You will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on outstanding debts, collection issues in collaboration with customers and internal teams, while developing strategies to minimize overdue accounts. 



This role is ideal for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a remote environment and values process improvement and accuracy. •	Follow up on overdue accounts via phone,
, and written correspondence

Requirements:

•	Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

title: MULTI-TASKING VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — HOME CARE OPERATIONS, RECRUITMENT & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
description:
MULTI-TASKING VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — HOME CARE OPERATIONS, RECRUITMENT & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



Company: GoldMinerz Home Care

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Schedule: 30 hours per week, Monday–Saturday

Pay: $3.00–$3.75 USD per hour, depending on experience and skills



ABOUT US



GoldMinerz Home Care is a New Jersey-based, licensed non-medical home care agency providing dependable, compassionate support to seniors and individuals who need assistance with daily living.



We are building our operations, caregiver team, referral relationships, and marketing presence. We are seeking an experienced, dependable, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant who can help manage daily operations and support business growth.



This is not just a data-entry position. We need someone who takes ownership of tasks, follows up without constant reminders, communicates professionally, and follows established procedures.



IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT



Prior experience working with a U.S.-based home care agency or a similar U.S. healthcare organization is mandatory.



You must understand how U.S. healthcare and home care operations work, have experience handling healthcare-related administrative responsibilities, and understand the importance of protecting confidential information.



Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements is required. You must be comfortable following strict company guidelines, maintaining accurate documentation, protecting sensitive information, and escalating issues when necessary.



Applicants without relevant prior U.S. home care or healthcare industry experience will not be considered.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Daily Operations & Administration



Manage business
s, calendars, reminders, and follow-ups.



Maintain organized Google Drive folders, spreadsheets, trackers, and records.



Track tasks, deadlines, outstanding items, and business priorities.



Prepare daily activity reports and weekly progress summaries.



Research vendors, software, business opportunities, and operational improvements.



Help document repeatable processes and standard operating procedures.



2. Caregiver Recruitment & Onboarding Coordination



Post approved caregiver job advertisements on appropriate platforms.



Review applications and organize qualified candidates.



Contact applicants by
, text, and phone.



Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates who do not respond.



Maintain a recruitment tracker showing application status, interview dates, documents outstanding, and next steps.



Coordinate onboarding paperwork and track completion of required documents.



Maintain an organized pipeline of available caregivers.



You will coordinate recruitment and paperwork but will not independently determine clinical qualifications or make final hiring decisions.



3. Referral Outreach & Business Development



Research potential referral partners throughout New Jersey, including senior centers, community organizations, social workers, discharge planners, and other appropriate organizations.



Identify the correct contact person and maintain an accurate referral database.



Make professional outbound calls and send approved introduction
s.



Follow up with contacts and schedule meetings for the owner.



Track outreach attempts, responses, meetings, and next follow-up dates.



Help develop professional relationships that may lead to appropriate client referrals.



You must be confident speaking professionally with people in the United States and representing our business courteously.



4. Marketing & Social Media



Create or coordinate marketing graphics using Canva.



Prepare approved social media posts and content calendars.



Maintain consistent business messaging across marketing channels.



Assist with caregiver recruitment advertisements and referral outreach materials.



Track engagement and recommend practical improvements.



Follow company branding, approved services, and marketing guidelines.



5. Administrative & Financial Tracking



Organize invoices, receipts, approved expenses, and payment records.



Maintain administrative trackers and flag missing documentation.



Assist with spreadsheet updates and monthly summaries.



Organize business documents for review by the owner or accountant.



You will not independently authorize payments, transfer funds, or make financial commitments.



6. Client Inquiry & Issue Coordination



Record incoming inquiries and route them to the appropriate person.



Maintain follow-up trackers for prospective clients and referral contacts.



Immediately escalate urgent client concerns, caregiver call-outs that may affect scheduled visits, safety issues, complaints, and privacy i
.



Follow established procedures instead of making clinical, emergency, or other decisions outside your authority.



This is a non-medical home care agency. You will not provide medical advice or independently make care decisions. Medicaid or DDD-related administrative work will be assigned only when applicable, authorized, and properly trained.



HIPAA, CONFIDENTIALITY & COMPLIANCE



Protecting client and caregiver information is a critical responsibility of this position.



You must:



Have working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements applicable to your role.



Understand the importance of protecting Protected Health Information (PHI) and other confidential information.



Access, use, and disclose information only as authorized and necessary for assigned duties.



Follow all company privacy policies, security procedures, documentation standards, and written instructions.



Never share confidential information through unauthorized
 accounts, messaging apps, or other channels.



Never download, copy, or disclose sensitive information without authorization.



Use approved systems and maintain secure work practices.



Immediately report suspected privacy breaches, security i
, or unauthorized disclosures.



Complete required confidentiality and privacy training and follow updated procedures.



Strict compliance is mandatory. Failure to follow established privacy, security, or company procedures may result in termination of access or employment, consistent with applicable agreements and law.



WORK SCHEDULE



30 hours per week.



Monday through Saturday, approximately 5 hours per day.



Exact working hours will be agreed upon before hiring.



Sufficient overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required for calls, follow-ups, and coordination.



You must be reliable and available during your agreed schedule.



State your exact availability in U.S. Eastern Time and specify your time zone in the Philippines.



PAY & GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



The starting pay range is $3.00–$3.75 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, calling ability, and independence.



At 30 hours per week, this equals approximately $90–$112.50 per week, or $390–$487.50 per average month before applicable platform or payment fees.



We are seeking a long-term working relationship. As the agency grows, additional hours or a full-time opportunity may be considered based on performance and business needs. Additional hours or pay are not guaranteed.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Prior professional experience with a U.S.-based home care agency or similar U.S. healthcare organization is mandatory.



Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements.



Experience handling healthcare administration, confidential documentation, or similar sensitive records.



Demonstrated ability to follow strict guidelines, policies, checklists, and established procedures.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Clear, professional communication and confidence making outbound calls.



Experience with caregiver recruitment, applicant coordination, onboarding documentation, or healthcare administrative support.



Experience making professional calls to U.S. businesses, applicants, or referral partners.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Experience with Google Workspace, Google Sheets,
, calendars, and online research.



Canva and social media experience is strongly preferred.



Bilingual ability is a plus. Candidates who speak English and Spanish, or another language useful for communicating with diverse clients, caregivers, and community members, are encouraged to apply.



Reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and quiet workspace.



Availability to work Monday–Saturday during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Willingness to complete identity and reference verification and sign a confidentiality agreement before accessing sensitive information.



DAILY REPORTING & ACCOUNTABILITY



At the end of each shift, submit a concise report covering:



Tasks completed.



Caregiver applicants contacted and recruitment progress.



Referral partners contacted, responses received, and follow-ups due.



Client inquiries or business opportunities requiring attention.



Marketing and administrative tasks completed.



Outstanding tasks and deadlines.



Problems or decisions requiring owner approval.



Your top three priorities for the next shift.



You will also provide a weekly summary of progress, results, challenges, and recommended next steps.



HOW TO APPLY



To demonstrate that you have read the entire post, begin your application with the exact words:



GOLDMINERZ ALL-ROUNDER



Please answer every question:



Which U.S. home care agency or healthcare organization have you worked with, and what was your position?



How many years of experience do you have in the U.S. home care or healthcare industry?



What specific home care operations have you handled, such as caregiver recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, client intake coordination, or compliance documentation?



Explain your understanding of HIPAA and how you protect confidential client information in your daily work.



Describe a strict policy or procedure you had to follow in a previous healthcare role.



What would you do if someone asked you to send confidential client information to an unauthorized
 address?



What experience do you have making outbound calls to U.S. businesses, applicants, or referral partners?



What tools do you use for spreadsheets,
, calendars, Canva, and task management?



Provide links or samples of social media graphics, marketing materials, or similar work you have created, if available.



State your exact availability in U.S. Eastern Time from Monday through Saturday.



Confirm that you have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and quiet workspace.



If a caregiver applicant stops responding and a referral partner has not replied to your
, how would you prioritize and follow up on both tasks?



Explain how you organize your day when several tasks have the same deadline.



Confirm whether you accept the advertised pay range of $3.00–$3.75 USD per hour.



Provide two professional references if available and confirm your willingness to complete identity and reference verification.



Do you speak any languages in addition to English? If yes, list each language and your proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing.



Applications that do not demonstrate relevant prior U.S. home care or healthcare experience will not be considered.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to:



A live video interview.



A short, paid practical assessment using fictional business and client information.



Reference and identity verification.



Additional appropriate screening before a final hiring decision.



We are looking for someone who is experienced, trustworthy, resourceful, detail-oriented, proactive, and committed to following strict procedures.



If you have real experience supporting a U.S. home care or healthcare organization and can help us manage operations, recruit dependable caregivers, build referral relationships, and protect confidential information, we would like to hear from you.

title: Loan Coordinator Assistant (Experienced Only) – Hawaii Remote Mortgage Operations
description:
JOB TITLE

Experienced Loan Coordinator Assistant – Remote Mortgage Operations



JOB OVERVIEW

Hawaii Financial Services, LLC (HIFIS) is a small, established mortgage company serving Hawaii home borrowers. We are hiring a dependable Loan Coordinator Assistant to help keep borrower files accurate, organized, current, and moving forward. No NMLS License is required as the Owner and only Loan Officer handles all communications with potential clients regarding loan programs, pricing, etc. which would trigger the NMLS License Requirements.



This is a detail-heavy mortgage operations position. It is not a general virtual-assistant or personal-assistant role. DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU HAVE MORTGAGE ASSISTANT/PROCESSING EXPERIENCE. Your application will be deleted.



You will work closely with the company owner. Your responsibilities will include borrower document follow-up, document review and organization, loan-system data entry, written verification ordering & tracking, wash lists creation, status updates, and direct client communications via
, phone calls & texts.



The right person takes ownership of assigned work, checks available information before asking questions, keeps accurate notes, follows through without repeated reminders, and knows when to escalate an issue.



This role does not independently originate, structure, approve, deny, or promise loan terms. Loan-program, qualification, pricing, compliance, and underwriting decisions are all completed by the owner & only licensed originator.



POSITION DETAILS



- Remote position

- Full-time

- Regular overlap with Hawaii Standard Time business hours is required

- Specific days and working hours will be agreed upon before hiring

- Training and responsibility will increase based on demonstrated accuracy, retention, judgment, and independence



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Borrower support and communication

- Help borrowers use the secure online application and document-upload process.

- Follow up by
, phone, and text using approved HIFIS templates and communication standards.

- Search all approved systems and file locations before asking a borrower to resend information.

- Provide prompt acknowledgment and accurate administrative status updates.

- Communicate delays and incomplete assignments before they affect a borrower or loan file.

- Keep the HIFIS Team included in all borrower-related communications as required.

- Refer questions about qualification, loan programs, pricing, approval, compliance, and possible deal-breakers to the owner.



Document review and file organization

- Preserve original borrower documents and never delete or overwrite source files.

- Download and prepare working copies of documents.

- Separate ZIP files, combine or optimize PDFs, and remove document passwords when authorized.

- Rename documents according to detailed HIFIS naming standards.

- Maintain the required borrower folder structure.

- Review documents for missing pages, incomplete date coverage, inconsistencies, duplicates, illegibility, and visible red flags.

- Record concerns clearly and alert the Team instead of making unsupported assumptions.



Loan-system setup and data entry

- Create and name loan files using HIFIS procedures.

- Enter borrower, residence, employment, asset, liability, referral, and other authorized information accurately.

- Cross-check names, addresses, dates, identification, tax documents, paystubs, bank statements, and application information.

- Maintain complete, clear, and professional file notes.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before submitting work for review.



Income, employment, and asset support

- Order written verifications of employment as directed.

- Track verification requests and receipt dates accurately.

- Organize paystubs, W-2s, 1099s, tax returns, K-1s, profit-and-loss statements, and supporting income documents.

- Prepare basic income worksheets according to company procedures, subject to review.

- Review bank and asset statements for ownership, statement periods, account identification, large deposits, earnest-money activity, and other items needing attention.

- Escalate inconsistent income, employment gaps, unexplained deposits, negative self-employment income, and other concerns immediately.



Wash lists, follow-up, and pipeline tracking

- Prepare clear first-round and follow-up lists of missing borrower documents.

- Separate items needed immediately from items that may be provided later.

- Confirm that an item is actually missing before requesting it.

- Track outstanding documents, written verifications, conditions, and assigned follow-up through completion.

- Update InfoDat and other internal systems daily with accurate actions, dates, ownership, and status notes.

- Report completed, pending, blocked, and overdue work before the end of each shift.

- Ask for help early when uncertainty, missing information, or workload could delay a file.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong attention to detail

- Must be self sufficient, working independently 

- Accurate data-entry and document-review skills

- Reliable attendance and availability during the agreed schedule

- Ability to manage competing deadlines and follow work through completion

- Ability to follow detailed written procedures and naming standards

- Willingness to use checklists, reference materials, and quality-control steps

- Good judgment about when to proceed and when to ask for help

- Ability to accept detailed feedback and retain corrections

- High integrity and discretion when handling confidential personal and financial information

- Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PDF tools, and cloud-based document systems

- A quiet, dependable remote workspace with reliable internet service

- Prior experience in a deadline-driven administrative or operations position



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

- U.S. residential mortgage processing or loan coordination

- Loan officer assistance/ processing

- Real estate transaction coordination

- High-volume client follow-up

- Calyx Point

- ShareFile

- Mortgage documentation and lending terminology

- Income-document review

- Creating or following standard operating procedures



A college degree is helpful but is not required when the applicant can demonstrate equivalent skills and experience. SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator pre-licensing education is helpful but does not replace HIFIS training or authorization.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE EVALUATED

Performance will be based on:

- Accuracy of data, documents, names, dates, and file notes

- Timely communication and status reporting

- Proper preservation, naming, and organization of documents

- Follow-through on outstanding items

- Daily visibility into completed, pending, and blocked work

- Compliance with the boundaries of the position

- Retention of corrections

- Increasing independence within assigned responsibilities



Training will begin with HIFIS procedures, document-control standards, systems, communication requirements, and supervised file work. Access and responsibilities will increase only after the employee demonstrates consistent accuracy, confidentiality, follow-through, and sound judgment.



HOW TO APPLY

Please use the subject line:

HIFIS LCA APPLICATION – [YOUR FULL NAME]



Your application must include:

1. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

2. The number of years you have worked in mortgage, lending, real estate, banking, accounting, or another deadline-driven operations position.

3. The mortgage and document-management systems you have used.

4. Your available working hours in Hawaii Standard Time.

5. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation in U.S. dollars.

6. A description of a time you found and corrected an inconsistency in a document, record, or customer file.

7. The answer to this question: What would you do if a borrower asked whether they qualify for a specific loan program?



Please attach your résumé and include the word “PINEAPPLE” at the end of your application. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered as it shows you have not read the entirety of this post.

title: Lead Qualification Caller for Australian Kitchen Cleaning Business
description:
ABOUT US

Practical Maintenance Services is a family-run business in Perth, Western Australia. Our kitchen exhaust team cleans the exhaust canopies and ducts in cafes and restaurants.



THE JOB

You will phone cafes and restaurants in Perth to qualify them as leads for our sales team. On each call you find out three things:

1. Who cleans their kitchen exhaust now?

2. When is the next clean due?

3. Roughly what do they pay?



This is not a sales role: no selling, no commission and no booking appointments. Our Perth sales team follows up when the timing is right.



You call from our web app in Google Chrome. It gives you one kitchen at a time, rings it for you at the click of a button, shows a short script, and you type the answers in. No spreadsheets and no dialling by hand.



HOURS AND PAY

- Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Perth time (same as Philippine time)

- US$600 to US$800 a month, depending on experience

- This is a contract role, starting with about 3 months to work through our Perth list, with ongoing work if it goes well

- Pay reviewed after the 3-month trial

- Work from home, training provided



WHAT YOU NEED

description:
### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious & Mind-Body Connection



**Remote | One-on-One | Zoom**



I am looking for an **excellent psychologist, therapist, mental-health coach, holistic life coach, or integrative wellness practitioner** who has deep knowledge of **personal transformation, subconscious patterns, emotional conditioning, behavior change, and mind-body approaches.**



I am currently healthy and am **not looking for treatment of a mental-health disorder or diagnosis.**



My goal is **personal growth and meaningful change**.



I want to become more motivated, improve how I represent myself, develop better habits and behaviors, overcome patterns that may be holding me back, and become the best version of myself.



## WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION DIFFERENT



I am looking for someone with a **deep and broad understanding of different approaches to personal transformation**, rather than someone who relies on only one standard therapeutic method.



For example, I am very interested in approaches such as:



* Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work

* Somatic and body-based approaches

* Inner-child work

* Hypnotherapy

* EFT / Tapping

* EMDR, when appropriately trained

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Breathwork

* Nervous-system regulation

* Subconscious and emotional-pattern work

* Visualization

* Mind-body approaches

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment and relational approaches

* Neuroplasticity and habit change

* Other experiential, integrative, holistic, or consciousness-based approaches



**These are examples, not a required checklist.**



If you know other powerful modalities or approaches that I have not mentioned, I want to hear about them.



In fact, discovering approaches I **don't already know about** is part of what I am looking for.



## 🧠 DEPTH OF KNOWLEDGE IS IMPORTANT



I want someone who understands the deeper relationship between:



**thoughts → emotions → nervous system → brain → subconscious/implicit patterns → behavior → habits → identity → change**



Knowledge of areas such as the **amygdala, subconscious processes, conditioning, neuroplasticity, habit formation, emotional learning, and behavior change** is a strong advantage.



I am also interested in the broader **mind-body and consciousness field**.



If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza's work**, meditation approaches, visualization, emotional-state work, or similar mind-body/consciousness teachings, that is a major plus.



You do not need to follow any particular teacher or agree with every theory.



I am looking for someone who can **understand these ideas intelligently, explain them clearly, and distinguish established evidence from theories, interpretations, or spiritual concepts.**



## 🎯 I WANT AN ACTUAL PLAN



The biggest thing I am looking for is someone who can take all this knowledge and turn it into **practical personal development.**



I don't simply want to have conversations every week.



I want someone who can help me:



* Identify the areas I want to change

* Understand the patterns behind them

* Determine which approaches may be useful

* Create a personalized plan

* Give me specific exercises and practices

* Set realistic goals

* Create weekly action steps

* Follow up on my progress

* Hold me accountable

* Evaluate what is working and what isn't

* Adjust the approach when necessary

* Help me actually implement the changes



For example, if we identify a particular pattern or behavior I want to change, I want us to be able to say:



**What is the pattern?

What may be contributing to it?

What are we going to work on?

What technique or exercise will we use?

What am I going to practice this week?

What will we review next session?**



I want the work to be **structured, personalized, and results-oriented.**



## 🌱 THIS IS ABOUT GROWTH, NOT DIAGNOSIS



I want to emphasize that I am **currently healthy and seeking personal development**, not treatment for a psychiatric or medical condition.



I am looking for someone who can work with a healthy person who wants to:



* Grow personally

* Change behaviors and habits

* Improve motivation

* Build confidence

* Improve self-expression

* Understand themselves more deeply

* Develop greater awareness

* Become more consistent

* Improve their relationships and communication

* Break unwanted patterns

* Create meaningful positive change



If you are a licensed psychologist or therapist, please state your credentials.



If you are a coach or practitioner rather than a licensed mental-health professional, that is also fine — **please clearly explain your actual training, certifications, experience, and scope of practice.**



## 👤 WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is someone who has **studied multiple approaches and developed a broad professional toolbox.**



You might be:



* A psychologist with additional integrative training

* A therapist trained in multiple modalities

* An IFS or somatic practitioner

* A holistic/integrative therapist

* A highly trained life or wellness coach

* A hypnotherapist

* A mind-body practitioner

* A meditation or mindfulness professional

* Or another practitioner with substantial training in personal transformation



The specific title is less important to me than **the depth of your knowledge, quality of your training, and your ability to actually help someone create change.**



## 🔎 APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer these carefully in your OnlineJobs.ph application.



### 1. Imagine that a healthy person tells you:



**“There are certain things about myself that I want to change. I understand intellectually what I should do, but I repeatedly fall back into the same patterns.”**



How would you approach helping that person create lasting change?



Please explain your actual approach rather than simply listing techniques.



### 2. What are the deeper or less commonly known modalities you have studied or practiced?



Please tell me about approaches **beyond standard CBT or general talk therapy** that you believe can be useful for personal transformation.



There is **no requirement to know the specific modalities listed in this post**. I am interested in discovering what YOU know.



### BONUS QUESTION

If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches**, please explain your familiarity.



## 💰 PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE

* Whether you offer an initial/trial session

**Please include your rate in your application.**

title: # Professional Voice Training Specialist / Vocal Coach — One-on-One Remote Training
description:
**Remote | One-on-One Training | Professional Voice Development**



I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one remotely.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding.**



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position.**



I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



- Vocal training and voice development

- **Vocal and throat anatomy**

- Breathing and breath support

- Vocal production

- Resonance

- Projection

- Pitch and pitch control

- Tone and vocal quality

- Articulation and clarity

- Vocal placement

- Voice strength and control

- Proper vocal technique

- Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

- Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



I am looking for someone who can determine **what is actually limiting the quality of my voice** and then develop exercises and techniques specifically for those areas.



## REMOTE ONE-ON-ONE TRAINING



Training will be conducted remotely through live video sessions.



You should be comfortable:



- Demonstrating exercises through video

- Listening carefully to my voice

- Watching my technique

- Correcting me in real time

- Explaining exactly what I am doing incorrectly

- Demonstrating the correct technique

- Having me repeat an exercise until I understand it

- Giving me exercises to practice between sessions

- Tracking my progress from session to session



I am looking for a **personalized training program**, not a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT — REMOTE AUDIO QUALITY & VOICE ASSESSMENT



Because this is voice training, **being able to accurately hear my voice is extremely important.**



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to conduct a Zoom call.



You should understand the limitations of remote voice training and know how to get the **clearest and most accurate representation of the voice possible through technology.**



You should be able to recommend the best setup for our sessions, including:



- Which platform you recommend for voice training — **Zoom, Google Meet,
, or another platform — and why**

- What type of microphone you recommend

- Whether I should use headphones or a headset

- How I should position myself in relation to the microphone

- What audio settings you recommend

- Whether any platform features such as **noise suppression, echo cancellation, automatic gain control, compression, or other audio processing** could interfere with accurately evaluating the voice

- Whether any settings should be changed or disabled during voice training

- Whether you recommend live sessions alone or also using **high-quality voice recordings**

- What type of recordings you would want me to provide before our first session

- How you distinguish actual characteristics of my voice from artifacts caused by the microphone, room, software, or internet connection



### I want you to be able to hear my actual voice.



If you believe another platform or setup would allow you to evaluate the voice more accurately than standard Zoom settings, **tell me what you recommend and why.**



You should have a thoughtful answer to this rather than simply saying, "Zoom is fine."



## VIDEO TEACHING EXPERIENCE



I am particularly interested in seeing **how you actually teach**, not just hearing about your qualifications.



If available, please provide a **short video of yourself actually teaching or coaching someone's voice.**



I would especially like to see how you:



- Listen to a student's voice

- Identify a problem

- Explain what you hear

- Demonstrate an exercise

- Correct the student

- Give feedback

- Adjust your approach based on the individual student



A singing performance or promotional video is **not as useful to me** as a video showing you actually teaching.



If you do not have a teaching video available, please explain your previous experience conducting one-on-one voice training.



## WHAT I EXPECT FROM THE TRAINING



I want the training to be structured and progressive.



I would like you to:



1. Assess my current voice

2. Identify the main areas that need improvement

3. Explain what you are hearing and why it matters

4. Establish specific goals

5. Create exercises for those areas

6. Teach me how to perform the exercises correctly

7. Give me a practice routine between sessions

8. Monitor my progress

9. Adjust the exercises as my voice develops

10. Help me build better control and consistency over time



I am interested in **actual voice development**, not simply being told to "speak with confidence."



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the **reason behind the exercises** you recommend.



If you recommend an exercise, I want to understand what it is intended to change or improve.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



- How many years you have professionally trained voices

title: Payroll/Bookkeeper - Experienced (Australian Client)
description:
About Us

Deryan Financial Group is a family-owned accounting and finance firm with over 40 years of experience helping clients make smarter financial and lending decisions.

We combine the expertise of mortgage broking and accounting to deliver end-to-end solutions — from securing the right loan to optimising tax and business outcomes.



The Opportunity

If you're an experienced bookkeeping or payroll professional who takes pride in accuracy, organisation, and compliance — this is your opportunity to take ownership of payroll processing and BAS preparation within our growing accounting division.

You'll manage the end-to-end payroll function for a portfolio of small business clients, prepare and lodge quarterly and monthly Business Activity Statements, and ensure client records are reconciled and compliant with current ATO, Fair Work and superannuation requirements. You'll work closely with our senior accountants and tax agents, keeping payroll and BAS cycles running to deadline so the team can focus on advisory and more complex work.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives on structure and recurring deadlines, and is confident managing a high-volume client base through weekly, fortnightly, monthly and quarterly cycles.



What You'll Do

• Process payroll for a portfolio of small business clients across weekly, fortnightly and monthly cycles, including new employee setup, terminations, leave and award interpretation.

• Lodge Single Touch Payroll (STP) events and complete end-of-year STP finalisation.

• Calculate and reconcile superannuation guarantee obligations and process quarterly super payments.

• Prepare and lodge monthly and quarterly BAS and IAS, including GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalments.

• Reconcile GST, payroll and superannuation accounts to the general ledger before each lodgement.

• Review client-supplied records and bookkeeping for completeness, following up directly with clients on missing or unclear information.

• Prepare BAS workpapers for senior accountant or tax agent review and sign-off, addressing review queries promptly.

• Manage related ATO correspondence, payment plans and follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate, well-organised client files and a lodgement calendar covering all payroll, super and BAS due dates.

• Communicate directly with clients regarding payroll queries, lodgement status and amounts payable.

• Identify and implement process improvements to streamline payroll and BAS administration.



About You

• 3+ years' experience processing payroll and preparing BAS in an Australian public practice, bookkeeping or tax agent environment (essential).

• Sound working knowledge of GST, PAYG withholding, PAYG instalments, superannuation guarantee and STP requirements.

• Working knowledge of modern awards, leave entitlements and Fair Work obligations.

• Experience with Xero Payroll and Xero (essential); MYOB, QuickBooks or KeyPay/Employment Hero an advantage.

• BAS Agent registration, or eligibility to register, highly regarded.

• Confident managing a high-volume client base with strong attention to recurring deadlines.

• Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.

• Professional communication skills and ability to manage client relationships independently.

• Organised, reliable, and proactive in identifying issues before they arise.



What's on Offer

• Competitive salary based on experience.

• Supportive, professional, and family-oriented team culture.

• Opportunity to build deep expertise in payroll and BAS compliance within a multi-disciplinary firm.

• Exposure to a wide range of clients and industries.





Please send your resume to 
 with a subject line Payroll/Bookkeeper.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller - Expired Listings (Florida)
description:
We buy houses in Florida. You'll work as an outbound cold caller on Mojo's 3-line power dialer, calling homeowners whose listings expired. Your job is to find owners who want to sell and have a reason to sell. You don't close deals, and you don't push anyone into a yes.



The job

- Dial your full shift on the power dialer

- Have real conversations: ask open questions, then listen

- Send a lead only when the owner wants to sell and has a story behind it — never from a voi
 or a "make me an offer"

- Log every call result in Mojo



Schedule and pay

- Monday–Friday, 10 AM–2 PM Eastern

- $5/hour



How to apply

1. Send your resume

2. Send a 60-second voice recording: introduce yourself and say why you'd be good on the phone



Skip a step and your application is filtered out. Shortlisted applicants get a 15-minute call.



The trial

The job starts with a 2-week paid trial, training included. Every hour is paid, including training. Both sides use the trial to d
 whether this is a fit.



What we look for: you show up for every shift, you dial your full shift, you're getting better each day, you ask questions, and the leads you send are real. Missing your first day without notice ends the trial.



We move fast. The 2-week trial is paid and training is included, but we expect you to hit the ground running. We check your numbers daily. If you're not showing up, dialing your full shift, and having real conversations by the end of week one, we'll end the trial early. If you're getting better every day and taking coaching, you'll fit right in.



What we measure

Every week we look at dialer hours, dials per hour, conversations per hour, and lead quality. We share the exact targets on day 1 of training.



Who we're looking for

Clear, natural English. You sound like a person, not a script. You're steady through a full shift of rejections, and you take coaching well.

title: SENIOR GOOGLE ADS & E-COMMERCE GROWTH SPECIALIST ⚡️💻📈
description:
HIRING: SENIOR GOOGLE ADS & E-COMMERCE GROWTH SPECIALIST ⚡️💻📈 



Work From Home – Philippines (100% Remote)



Google Ads | Performance Max | E-commerce Analytics | ROAS | Shopify | Reporting



Company: Skin O2 – Australian Professional Skincare & E-commerce Brand

Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Hours: 15 hours per week

Engagement: Long-term independent subcontractor

Hourly Rate: AUD $25- 65  per hour, depending on experience and proven results

Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience



ABOUT SKIN O2



Skin O2 is an established Australian skincare and professional beauty business operating in the e-commerce and professional skincare market.



We are seeking an experienced, commercially minded Senior Google Ads & E-commerce Growth Specialist to take ownership of our Google advertising performance, campaign optimisation, e-commerce sales analysis and management reporting.



This is a hands-on specialist position for someone who understands how to grow e-commerce revenue profitably.



We are not looking for someone who simply monitors campaigns or produces basic reports. We want someone who can independently analyse performance, identify opportunities, implement improvements and demonstrate measurable commercial results.



1. GOOGLE ADS MANAGEMENT & GROWTH



You will be responsible for managing and optimising our Google advertising campaigns, including:



- Google Search campaigns.

- Google Shopping campaigns.

- Performance Max campaigns.

- AI Max for Search campaigns.

- Remarketing and audience targeting.

- Campaign structure and keyword strategy.

- Search-term analysis and negative keyword management.

- Bidding strategies and target ROAS (tROAS).

- Advertising budget allocation and optimisation.

- Performance Max asset-group optimisation and testing.

- Product and category-level advertising performance.

- Seasonal campaigns, promotions and product launches.

- Black Friday and major promotional campaigns.



You must understand how to scale profitable campaigns while controlling advertising expenditure.



2. E-COMMERCE SALES & CONVERSION OPTIMISATION



You will analyse our e-commerce performance and identify opportunities to increase revenue and conversion rates.



Responsibilities include:



- Monitoring Shopify sales and product performance.

- Analysing website traffic, conversion rates and average order value.

- Identifying underperforming products and categories.

- Improving landing-page and product-page performance.

- Identifying customer journey and checkout issues.

- Improving calls to action and website usability.

- Reviewing mobile conversion performance.

- Planning and implementing A/B tests.

- Measuring the commercial impact of changes.



Experience with Shopify and e-commerce conversion optimisation is essential.



Experience with testing platforms such as Shoplift, Intelligems, VWO, Convert or Optimizely is highly desirable.



3. ADVANCED ANALYTICS & CONVERSION TRACKING



You must be confident working with:



- Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Google Ads conversion tracking.

- E-commerce purchase and revenue tracking.

- Google Merchant Center.

- Attribution and conversion analysis.

- Looker Studio dashboards.

- Shopify reporting and sales data.



You must be able to identify discrepancies between Google Ads, GA4 and Shopify reporting and investigate their causes.



We need reliable data to support commercial decisions.



4. MANAGEMENT REPORTING & BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE



An important part of this position is producing clear, meaningful performance reports for management.



You will prepare:



Weekly Performance Updates



- Advertising spend and revenue.

- ROAS and CPA.

- Campaign performance.

- Significant changes or emerging problems.

- Recommended immediate actions.



Monthly Management Reports



- Revenue and advertising expenditure.

- ROAS, CPA and conversion trends.

- Performance against targets.

- Comparison with the previous month.

- Strongest and weakest campaigns.

- Product and category performance.

- Promotional and seasonal performance.

- Campaign changes and experiments undertaken.

- Problems, opportunities and commercial risks.

- Recommendations and priorities for the next month.



Reports must explain:



1. What happened?

2. Why did it happen?

3. What did you change?

4. What was the result?

5. What should happen next?



We want commercial analysis and practical recommendations, not just spreadsheets or automated dashboard screenshots.



Advanced Excel and Looker Studio skills are highly desirable.



5. SEO & AI SEARCH VISIBILITY



You will also contribute to improving Skin O2's online product discovery and organic visibility.



Experience with the following is desirable:



- Technical and on-page SEO.

- Google Search Console.

- Keyword research.

- Product metadata and structured data.

- Schema markup.

- Google Merchant Center and product feeds.

- Internal linking and crawlability.

- Google organic product visibility.

- Emerging AI search visibility across ChatGPT and Gemini.



You should understand established SEO practices and be able to distinguish them from emerging AI-search optimisation techniques.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Applicants must demonstrate:



- Minimum 5 years of Google Ads and e-commerce marketing experience.

- Advanced Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max knowledge.

- Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.

- Proven results improving ROAS, CPA and e-commerce revenue.

- Strong understanding of tROAS and automated bidding.

- Experience with product feeds and Google Merchant Center.

- Advanced GA4 and Google Tag Manager knowledge.

- Experience analysing Shopify sales and conversion data.

- Ability to produce professional management reports.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and manage priorities.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home environment.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



- Australian or international e-commerce experience.

- Skincare, beauty, cosmetics or consumer-product experience.

- Shopify optimisation.

- Looker Studio dashboard development.

- Advanced Excel and Google Sheets.

- CRO and A/B testing.

- Technical SEO.

- HTML, CSS or basic JavaScript.

- AI-assisted marketing analysis and reporting.



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



This is a long-term, ongoing subcontractor opportunity for an experienced professional seeking a stable working relationship with an Australian e-commerce business.



- 15 hours per week.

- 100% remote – work from home in the Philippines.

- Flexible working arrangements, subject to agreed hours and deliverables.

- Direct communication with Australian management.

- Ongoing responsibilities for Google Ads management, optimisation and reporting.

- Regular communication regarding campaign activity, priorities and business objectives.

- Opportunity for additional hours as the business grows.



The successful subcontractor must be organised, proactive, reliable and capable of independently managing their responsibilities with minimal supervision.



We are looking to establish a long-term professional working relationship rather than engage someone for short-term projects.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your CV and expected hourly rate in AUD.

2. A summary of your Google Ads and e-commerce experience.

3. Examples of Google Ads accounts you have personally managed.

4. Actual campaign results, including ROAS, CPA, revenue and advertising budgets.

5. Examples of Performance Max and Shopping campaigns.

6. An example of a monthly e-commerce performance report or Looker Studio dashboard you personally prepared.

7. Examples of conversion optimisation or A/B testing.

8. Your experience with Shopify, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

9. Your weekly availability and preferred working hours.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer the following five questions:



1. Declining ROAS



If an e-commerce Google Ads account experiences a sudden decline in ROAS, how would you investigate and identify the cause?



2. Diagnosing Sales Performance



How do you determine whether declining sales are caused by advertising performance, tracking issues, seasonality, website conversion or changes to promotional activity?



3. Performance Max Optimisation



How do you manage and optimise Performance Max campaigns, including asset groups, product feeds, budgets and tROAS?



4. Management Reporting



What information would you include in a monthly management report for an Australian e-commerce business?



5. Shopify Conversion Optimisation



What three practical changes would you initially investigate to improve the performance of an underperforming Shopify product page?



IMPORTANT APPLICATION REQUIREMENT



Please include the words GROWTH ENGINEER in the first paragraph of your application.



Applications without this phrase or without demonstrable practical Google Ads experience may not be considered.



WHO WE WANT



We are looking for a commercially focused specialist who can:



PLAN → IMPLEMENT → TEST → MEASURE → ANALYSE → REPORT → OPTIMISE → GROW



You will be trusted to take ownership of our Google advertising performance and provide management with accurate reporting, clear analysis and practical recommendations.



If you are an experienced Google Ads and e-commerce specialist who enjoys taking responsibility for measurable business growth, we would love to hear from you.



SKIN O2

Australian E-commerce & Professional Skincare Business

title: Senior Klaviyo & Customer Lifecycle Growth Specialist ⚡️💻📈
description:
Senior Klaviyo & Customer Lifecycle Growth Specialist ⚡️💻📈



Remote – Philippines | Long-Term Project / Subcontractor | Hourly Contract



Rate: A$15–A$55 per hour (AUD), depending on demonstrated expertise



About the Project



We are an established Australian skincare and beauty e-commerce business, Skin O2, looking for an exceptional Senior Klaviyo & Customer Lifecycle Growth Specialist to audit, restructure and significantly improve our existing Klaviyo marketing system.



We are looking for someone who specialises in Klaviyo automation, advanced customer segmentation,
 marketing, customer acquisition, retention and subscription growth.



This is not a junior
 marketing or general VA position.



We need an experienced specialist who understands how to turn customer data, intelligent segmentation and automated customer journeys into increased revenue, repeat purchases, customer lifetime value and new customer acquisition.



You will initially review our existing Klaviyo account, identify missed opportunities and implement a comprehensive improved
 marketing and customer lifecycle strategy.



We are looking for someone who can independently lead this project and demonstrate proven results from previous e-commerce clients.



Key Responsibilities



1. Klaviyo Account Audit & Strategy



- Conduct a comprehensive audit of our existing Klaviyo account.

- Review existing flows, automation, segmentation, campaigns and integrations.

- Identify gaps, outdated automations, duplication and missed revenue opportunities.

- Review existing customer data, subscriber acquisition and database quality.

- Develop a strategic improvement plan to increase
-generated revenue.

- Review Shopify and Klaviyo integration and data synchronisation.



2. Advanced Klaviyo Flows & Automation



Create, restructure and optimise high-converting automated flows, including:



- Welcome series and new subscriber acquisition.

- Website visitor and browse abandonment.

- Abandoned cart and checkout recovery.

- Post-purchase customer journeys.

- Product education and product recommendation flows.

- Cross-selling and upselling campaigns.

- Replenishment and repeat-purchase reminders.

- Customer reactivation and win-back campaigns.

- Customer review and referral requests.

- VIP customer recognition and loyalty campaigns.

- Lapsed customer and inactive subscriber re-engagement.



All flows must incorporate appropriate triggers, conditional splits, behavioural targeting, timing, exclusions and personalisation.



3. Customer Segmentation & Database Growth



Develop sophisticated customer segments to improve targeting, engagement and revenue.



This includes:



- New subscribers and prospective customers.

- First-time purchasers.

- Repeat purchasers.

- High-value and VIP customers.

- Customers by product category and purchasing behaviour.

- Customers interested in particular skincare concerns or product ranges.

- High-engagement and low-engagement subscribers.

- Lapsed and inactive customers.

- Customers likely to purchase again.

- Subscription customers and subscription prospects.

- Customers suitable for cross-selling and upselling.



Develop strategies to increase new
 subscriber registrations through improved website pop-ups, sign-up forms, targeted offers and customer acquisition campaigns.



4. Subscription Growth & Retention



Develop dedicated subscription marketing campaigns and automated customer journeys.



Experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses is highly desirable.



Areas of focus include:



- New subscription acquisition campaigns.

- Subscription welcome and onboarding flows.

- Subscription conversion from existing customers.

- Subscription renewal reminders.

- Upcoming order notifications.

- Replenishment reminders.

- Subscription upgrade and cross-sell opportunities.

- Failed payment recovery.

- Subscription cancellation prevention.

- Customer retention and churn reduction.

- Subscription reactivation campaigns.



5. VIP, Cross-Selling & Upselling Revenue



Build targeted campaigns that increase customer lifetime value and average order value.



We want to identify opportunities to:



- Introduce complementary skincare products.

- Recommend products based on previous purchases.

- Encourage customers to purchase additional products.

- Develop VIP customer campaigns and exclusive offers.

- Reward repeat purchasers.

- Introduce customers to new product ranges.

- Increase purchase frequency and customer loyalty.



6. Performance & Revenue Optimisation



- Review
-attributed revenue and conversion performance.

- Identify underperforming flows and campaigns.

- Conduct A/B testing of subject lines, offers, creative and messaging.

- Improve click-through rates and purchase conversion.

- Monitor deliverability, bounce rates and unsubscribe rates.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer lifetime value.

- Provide clear recommendations based on actual customer and revenue data.



The objective is to build a high-performing Klaviyo system that consistently contributes to business growth.



Essential Experience & Qualifications



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



- Minimum 5 years of professional
 marketing and Klaviyo experience.

- Demonstrated expert-level knowledge of Klaviyo.

title: EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager
description:
EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager

Protect the Founder’s Time. Let Founder do what they're best at.

Remote, Philippines | U.S. Eastern overlap | Full-time

50 hours per week



Compensation and Validation

$2,500/month during the first 90-day validation period

First 14 days are a paid work trial using real work

Operators who far exceed the agreed performance standard move to a $3,500/month base on Day 90, with additional upside as impact and ownership expand. 

Performance is reviewed weekly. Compensation and scope are formally reviewed at Day 90

This is not pay for activity.



You do not earn more by being online, maintaining a task list, or sending pleasant updates. You earn more by finishing meaningful work, protecting CEO's time, solving problems without being chased, and permanently removing work from his plate.



The Day 90 review will consider:

Meaningful work completed

Founder time and attention saved

Recurring responsibilities removed from CEO

Follow-ups eliminated

Blockers solved without founder intervention

Health, personal, and CEO priorities moved forward

Problems converted into delegation, automation, systems, or deletion

Whether CEO had to chase, remind, or re-explain work

If you exceed the agreed standard, your base increases to $3,500/month beginning with the next pay period. Exceptional performance can earn additional upside and expanded ownership.

There will be no surprise standards introduced at Day 90.



This role is for a rare kind of person

You see unfinished work and feel compelled to finish it.

You do not need a founder to explain every obvious next step.

You get genuine satisfaction from taking chaos, pressure, loose ends, and half-formed ideas and turning them into:

“Done. Here’s what changed.”

You are not looking for a job where you wait for instructions and keep a task list updated.

You want to become the person who makes an overloaded founder dramatically lighter.



Why this role exists

Ceo is a visionary.

His highest-value work is thinking, creating, d
, leading, and building the future.

His weakness is that once ideas leave his head, a mountain of execution follows:

Health tasks

Appointments

Records

Research

Follow-ups

Travel

Personal logistics

Errands

Vendors

Scheduling

Projects

Loose ends

When those things remain unfinished, they return to Dylan’s brain. He becomes the reminder system, scheduler, researcher, project manager, and emergency backup.

That steals his time, energy, health, focus, and ability to be fully himself.

Your job is to remove that burden.

Not organize it.

Not report on it.

Finish it.

Your mission

You are the execution engine behind Ceo’s vision.

You will take messy voice notes, ideas, priorities, and unfinished work and turn them into completed outcomes without requiring Ceo to project-manage the middle.



You will:

Clarify the desired outcome.

Identify the next actions.

Own or coordinate the execution.

Push through blockers.

Close the loop with proof.

Prevent the same problem from returning.

Your goal is for Ceo to spend more of his life being authentic by doing only what he should do. 

Thinking

Creating

D

Leading

Building the future

You handle the mountain of execution that allows him to stay in that role.



What you will own

Finish a large volume of meaningful work from Ceo’s active to-do list every day

Protect his calendar, deep work, recovery, health, and personal priorities

Drive health administration from approved decision to completion

Schedule appointments, gather records, prepare documents, and close follow-ups

Turn voice notes and ideas into prioritized action and completed projects

Own travel, Trip preparation, errands, purchases, vendors, reservations, and personal logistics

Chase people, enforce deadlines, remove blockers, and find another route when the first route fails

Keep open loops visible and moving

Identify recurring friction and eliminate it through delegation, automation, systemization, or deletion

Give concise updates containing what finished, what changed, what is blocked, your recommendation, and the next date

Protect team from being diverted into Ceo's personal and CEO-level execution work

You do not make medical, relationship, values, or major financial decisions. You own the execution around those decisions and escalate only what truly requires the CEO.

Health-related information must be handled only through approved, privacy-compliant systems and workflows.



What a great day looks like

At the beginning of the day, you know:

What CEO wants moved

What matters most

What can be handled without him

What needs clarification

What must be finished today

During the day, you move mountains:

Close open loops

Push delayed people

Complete health and personal tasks

Convert ideas into action

Remove friction

Protect CEOs time

Solve problems before they reach him

At the end of the day, CEO should not be asking, “What happened with that?”

He should be able to see:

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.
