title: AI Expert - Service Delivery, AI Operations & Personal Assistant (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover and manage Instagram accounts. Our customers order through an app, and a lot of our operation runs on AI assistants that talk to customers, answer questions and move orders along.



The AI does a lot - but it cannot be left alone. That is the job.



*** THIS IS A TECHNICAL ROLE. YOU MUST BE AN EXPERT IN AI. ***

We are not looking for a general VA who has "used ChatGPT a few times." We need someone who is genuinely excellent with Claude and ChatGPT and uses BOTH every day for real work (not just for writing
s), keeps up with every new AI model and tool as it comes out, understands how they work and why they fail, and can fix them - AND who can also handle customer support, service delivery, and act as the owner's personal assistant. If AI is not already one of your strongest skills, please do not apply.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO WILL CHALLENGE ME

I do not want someone who says "yes sir" to everything. If my plan is wrong, tell me. If there is a faster or smarter way, show me. I value someone who pushes back with a good reason far more than someone who simply agrees.



We have interviewed many people who say they are good with AI but cannot show anything they have built. We want the opposite: someone who has actually built things with AI (agents, automations, custom GPTs, scripts, small apps), can show them to us on screen in the interview, and will push back when we are wrong. If you think the way we run our AI is a bad idea, say so and show us a better way. Real coding experience (Python, JavaScript, APIs) is a big plus.



EXCELLENT ENGLISH - WRITTEN AND SPOKEN

You will write to customers every day and talk with me on calls. Your writing must be clear, natural and typo-free, and you must be comfortable speaking English on a call without a script. We ask for a short voice recording (question 11).



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING



1) WATCHING OVER OUR AI ASSISTANTS (about half your time)



We have several AI assistants that message customers directly - one handles sales conversations, one handles order updates, one handles support tickets, and others. All of them are in your scope. Your job is to be the human checking their work:



- Read what the AI said to customers and spot anything wrong: a made-up answer, a promise we cannot keep, the wrong price, a rude or robotic reply, or the same message sent over and over

- Flag it, pause that assistant yourself if it is doing damage (you will have the controls - we would rather you stop it at 10pm than wait for us), and tell us what happened

- Notice patterns, not just one-off mistakes ("it keeps doing X with this type of customer")

- Step in and reply as a human when the AI is out of its depth

- Work out WHY the AI got it wrong (bad instructions, missing information, a hallucination, a loop) and write or suggest the fix to its instructions (prompts), then check the fix actually worked



This part is technical. You need to understand how AI models behave - hallucinations, system prompts, context, why they repeat themselves or invent progress - well enough to diagnose a problem, not just report it. You also need to be the person who reads something that sounds confident and thinks "hang on, that's not right."



2) CUSTOMER SUPPORT TICKETS (about a third of your time)



- Answer customer questions and complaints in our support system

- Chase customers for information we need to finish their order

- Keep tickets moving so nothing sits ignored for days



3) SERVICE DELIVERY



- Complete customer orders by hand on our phones, following a written step-by-step guide

- It is roughly 10-15 minutes per order once you know it

- Tell the customer when it is done, or ask for what is missing



4) PERSONAL ASSISTANT TO THE OWNER (as needed, throughout the day)



- Manage my inbox, calendar and scheduling, and keep me on top of what needs my attention

- Research, organise documents and notes, follow up on tasks and reminders

- Handle ad-hoc requests quickly and reliably - using AI to get them done faster and better

- Be proactive: tell me what is falling through the cracks before I have to ask



BEING HONEST ABOUT THE WORK



- A lot of it is repetitive. Reading AI conversations and completing the same order checklist. Some people find that steady and satisfying; others are bored in a month and quit. Please know yourself.

- It is screen-heavy and detail-heavy. Accuracy matters far more than speed.

- It is 8 hours a day, 6 days a week. Please only apply if that genuinely suits you.

- You will find mistakes, including ours. We want someone who says "this is wrong" rather than someone who goes along with it.

- What it is not: no cold calling, no sales targets, no content creation.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



REQUIRED - EXPERT-LEVEL AI SKILLS:

- You use Claude AND ChatGPT every single day for real work (Gemini and others a plus) - not just for writing
s

- You stay up to date on AI: you know when new models and tools come out, you try them, and you can tell us what is actually better and what is hype

- You write strong prompts and instructions, and you can rewrite a badly-behaving AI's instructions so it stops making the same mistake

- You understand why AI models hallucinate, lose context, repeat themselves or make promises - and how to prevent it

- You are technically confident: comfortable reading logs, JSON, dashboards and admin panels, and learning a new system quickly without hand-holding

- Bonus: automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), APIs, custom GPTs/AI agents, or some coding/scripting (Python, JavaScript)



AND ALSO:



- Excellent written AND spoken English. You message customers directly and speak with me on calls. Clear, natural, warm and typo-free.

- Judgement. The core skill is spotting when something is wrong even though it sounds convincing.

- Careful and consistent. One wrong tap can cost a customer their appeal.

- Very comfortable with phones, two-factor authentication, backup codes and technology in general.

- A reliable setup. Stable internet and power for your whole shift, and a quiet place to work.

- Completely trustworthy. You will have access to customer account details. This is monitored and logged, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will start on a paid trial.



Nice to have: customer support, content moderation, social media management or quality assurance experience. (AI expertise is NOT a nice-to-have - it is required.)



THE DETAILS



- Pay: $4 to $5 per hour depending on your skills and test results, paid hourly. Paid on time, every time.

- Hours: 8 hours a day, 6 days a week (48 hours a week). Our customers are in Europe, so your shift falls within roughly 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time.

- Trial: 1-2 week PAID trial on real work before we commit long-term.

- Long-term and stable. We want someone for years, not weeks.

- Real authority: you can pause an AI assistant yourself when it is doing damage. We trust the person doing the watching to act, not to file a report and wait.

- Everything is browser-based on our systems. You need a reliable computer and a stable internet connection, nothing else.

- Your rate is reviewed after the first 3 months, based on your results.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 11 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your message with the words "human check" so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Please include how many customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias,
,
, or none). Include any personal/executive assistant experience too. If you have no support experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT SOMEONE ELSE'S MISTAKE AT WORK OR DISAGREED WITH YOUR BOSS - what it was, how you noticed, what you said or did, and what happened. One short paragraph. This is the closest thing to the actual job, so please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



"Hi! Good news, we're sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We'll have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!"



The truth at that moment: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer messages: "this is taking forever, I want a refund." Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact message you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work 8 hours a day, 6 days a week, within the 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time window. Also tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. YOUR AI SKILLS - two parts:

   a) Which AI tools and models you use (we especially want Claude and ChatGPT), how often, the newest AI model or tool you have tried in the last month and what you thought of it, and the most technical thing you have done with AI (a custom GPT, an AI agent, an automation, an API integration, a complex prompt system). Be specific - links or screenshots are welcome.

   b) Our AI assistant (question 4 above) keeps telling customers their order is being worked on "right now" and will be done "today, guaranteed" when it has no way of knowing that. Write the exact instruction you would add to its system prompt to stop it, and explain in 1-2 sentences why the AI does this in the first place.



10. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



11. A 60-90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING in English (a Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar link). Unscripted: tell us about one AI tool you use every day and one thing you think most businesses get wrong about AI.



Everyone who follows all 11 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.

title: AI VIDEO edittor UGC TEAM LEADER-EXPIRIENCED ONLY
description:
ENIOR VIRAL VIDEO EDITOR – AI CONTENT SPECIALIST | TOP 1% ONLY



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | Premium Pay for Exceptional Talent



This is NOT an entry-level editing position.



We are building a high-volume, AI-powered content company operating multiple social media brands targeting millions of viewers across the United States.



We are looking for an elite short-form video editor who understands exactly what makes content go viral, keeps people watching, and turns viewers into followers, leads, and customers.



We don't want someone who simply knows how to edit videos.



We want someone who has already helped build massive social media channels and knows how to repeat that success.



If you've worked with major content creators, managed videos that consistently achieve hundreds of thousands or millions of views, and understand high-converting direct-response content, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON



Our company is scaling multiple AI-driven social media brands, primarily targeting American audiences.



We produce high-volume short-form content across Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Our content includes:



AI-generated spokesperson and avatar videos



Viral storytelling and educational content



High-converting product and affiliate marketing videos



AI-generated lifestyle and product demonstrations



Short-form videos built around proven viral concepts



We already have production systems, AI tools, scripts, and content workflows in place.



We're looking for someone who can take these resources and produce genuinely world-class content.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You must have:



✅ Proven viral results: A portfolio of videos you've personally edited that achieved 500K, 1M, 5M+ views.



✅ Experience with large creators: Previous work with major social media channels, established influencers, or high-volume content companies.



✅ Advanced AI production skills: Experience working with AI-generated footage, AI avatars, voiceovers, generative video tools, and modern editing workflows.



✅ Exceptional retention editing: You understand hooks, pacing, visual movement, pattern interrupts, sound design, and how to stop people scrolling.



✅ Direct-response marketing knowledge: You know how to produce content that generates comments, clicks, leads, and purchases—not just views.



✅ High-end editing ability: Expert-level knowledge of Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or equivalent professional tools.



✅ Creative independence: You can take a script, understand its objective, and deliver an outstanding finished video without constant instructions.



✅ Extremely high standards: You notice the small details. Bad AI visuals, awkward movements, unnatural voices, weak transitions, and poor captions are unacceptable.



WHAT MAKES YOU DIFFERENT



The average editor follows instructions.



An exceptional editor understands why a video works and improves it before anyone asks.



You should be able to watch a viral video, reverse-engineer its success, and create an original piece of content with the same level of impact.



You understand the psychology of short-form content.



You know that the first two seconds can determine whether a video succeeds or fails.



You know when a scene has stayed on screen too long.



You understand how to build curiosity, deliver value, and naturally transition into a compelling call to action.



Most importantly, you care about the performance of your videos after they're published.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Edit high-performing AI-generated short-form videos daily.



Transform scripts, AI-generated footage, and references into premium finished videos.



Improve hooks, captions, pacing, audio, transitions, and overall production quality.



Identify weak AI-generated scenes and replace or improve them.



Study winning videos and adapt successful techniques to our brands.



Work with AI content generation tools to improve production efficiency.



Review performance metrics and continuously improve retention and conversion.



Maintain consistent quality while working in a high-volume production environment.



Contribute creative ideas, improvements, and new production techniques.



COMPENSATION AND CAREER OPPORTUNITY



This is a serious long-term position with a growing content company.



We are prepared to pay premium rates for someone who genuinely delivers elite results.



What we offer:



Competitive USD salary based on proven ability.



Performance-based bonuses for exceptional results.



Reliable, consistent, long-term work.



Access to premium AI tools and production technology.



Creative freedom and genuine ownership of your work.



Opportunity to grow into a Lead Editor or Head of Video Production role.



The chance to help scale multiple major social media brands.



We are not looking for the cheapest editor.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and skilled AP/AR Specialist to join our team. This role is integral in managing our financial transactions related to accounts payable and accounts receivable functions. The AP/AR Specialist will be responsible for conducting credit card reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and maintaining accurate financial records using the Xero accounting software. This position demands a high level of accuracy, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 



Responsibilities 

Accounts Payable Management 

Process accounts payable transactions accurately and timely, including invoice verification, coding, and data entry into the Xero accounting system. 

Perform credit card reconciliation to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled with corresponding invoices or receipts. 

Review and reconcile vendor statements, resolving any discrepancies or outstanding issues with payments. 

Prepare and process payment runs, including electronic transfers, checks, and ACH payments, according to company policies and payment terms. 

Communicate with vendors regarding payment inquiries, invoice disputes, and payment delays maintaining positive relationships. 

Accounts Receivable Management 

Generate customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring they include all necessary documentation and billing details. 

Record and reconcile customer payments received via various channels, such as checks, credit cards, and electronic transfers, ensuring accurate entry in the Xero accounting system. 

Conduct regular bank reconciliations to match customer payments with corresponding invoices, updating accounts receivable records as needed. 

Follow up on overdue invoices through
, phone calls, or written correspondence to facilitate timely collections and reduce outstanding balances. 

Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and escalate unresolved payment issues to management as necessary. 

Financial Reporting and Compliance 

Assist with month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, and expense allocations, to ensure accurate financial reporting. 

Review and resolve discrepancies in customer accounts, such as chargebacks, refunds, and adjustments, maintaining accurate receivables balances. 

Prepare aging analysis reports, cash flow projections, and other financial analyses to support accounts receivable performance. 



Requirements 

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field preferred. 

Proven experience in accounts payable and accounts receivable roles, including credit card reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and invoice processing. 

Proficiency in using accounting software, with a strong preference for Xero, to manage financial transactions and reconciliations. 

Willingness to take XERO certification (facilitated by the client) 

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, record-keeping, and financial analysis. 

Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines. 

Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, for interacting with vendors, customers, and internal stakeholders. 

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively within a team environment. 

Knowledge of accounting principles, GAAP, and relevant regulatory requirements governing accounts payable and accounts receivable functions. 

Problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 

Proficient in Excel; Spreadsheets 



Desirable 

Experience in handling complex financial records and conducting detailed financial analysis. 



Software 

Xero accounting software expertise is required. 

Experience Yardi (Property Management Software) - is a plus 



Education 

A tertiary qualification in accounting, finance, or a related field is highly preferred.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex 

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role for an Australian company

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:

title: B2B Cold Caller / Sales Representative, US Fire Protection Design Firm (Night Shift, Hourly + Commission)
description:
About us

We’re a US-based fire protection design firm working with contractors in all 50 states. We design fire alarm and sprinkler systems for the contractors who install them. We’re looking for a confident, experienced cold caller to open new contractor accounts.



What you’ll do



Cold call US fire alarm, sprinkler and electrical contractors from lead lists we provide

Get past gatekeepers and reach estimators, project managers and owners

Ask each contractor to send one project for us to quote

Follow up by phone and
 until they do

Log every call and next step in Zoho CRM

Report your numbers daily and weekly



You will not close large contracts by phone or quote prices. Your job is to open the door. Our team handles the rest.



Pay



$4.00/hour, paid via Wise

Plus a 3% commission on every invoice paid by new contractors you bring in, for their first 12 months

Strong performers will be offered full-time employment with benefits and then raise to 5% commission after 1 year if successful.



Training

You get 3 weeks of paid training before live calls start. It covers our services, fire alarm and sprinkler basics, how to read our drawings, the call script, objection handling, and Zoho CRM. You don’t need fire protection experience. We’ll teach you the minimum, you won't need expert detail knowledge, just enough to know what you're talking about.



Schedule

US business hours, Monday to Friday. That’s a night shift in the Philippines, about 9:00 pm to 6:00 am PHT.



Requirements



At least 1 year of B2B cold calling experience with US clients (appointment setting or outbound sales)

Excellent, natural spoken English. US contractors must be able to understand you easily on the first try, over the phone.

Comfortable hearing “no” many times a day and still making the next call

Experience with any CRM (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

A quiet, dedicated workspace

Stable internet (25 Mbps or more) plus a backup connection

Your own laptop/PC and a noise-cancelling headset



Nice to have



Experience selling to construction, trades or contractors in the U.S.

Experience with Zoho CRM



How to apply

Applications without a complete Loom video won’t be reviewed.



Start your message with the words “Fire Pro Caller” so we know you read the full post.



Record one Loom video, 6 to 8 minutes, with your camera on and your headset on, in the room you’d work from. Do all five parts in one take. Don’t edit or cut the video. 



Part 1: Introduce yourself (1 to 2 minutes, no script). Your name, where you’ve done cold calling, who you called, what you sold, how many calls you made a day, and your best result. 



Part 2: Read this paragraph out loud (about 1 minute).



“Our firm designs fire alarm and fire sprinkler systems for contractors across the United States. Every project includes the device layout, the riser diagram, battery and voltage drop calculations, and hydraulic calculations for sprinkler systems. When the authority having jurisdiction requires it, we also handle the permit submittal and respond to the fire marshal’s comments. Most contractors start by sending us one project to quote. If the numbers make sense, they send the next one.”



Part 3: Tell us about a real call (1 to 2 minutes, no script). Describe the hardest cold call you’ve ever had. What did the person say, what did you say, and how did it end? 



Part 4: Mock cold call (about 1 minute). Pretend you’re calling Rick, the owner of a small US fire alarm company. Introduce yourself, explain in one or two sentences why you’re calling, and ask him to send you one project to quote. 



Part 5: Handle the objection (about 1 minute). Rick says: “We do all our design in-house. We don’t need you.” Show us exactly what you would say next.



In your message, also tell us:



Your earliest start date

Your internet speed (send a screenshot from speedtest.net) and what your backup connection is

Whether you’ve used Zoho CRM before



We will reply only to applicants whose video is complete and whose English is clear and natural.

Introduce Apollo Media’s services and explain how we help remodelers capture more inquiries and book more jobs.

Qualify prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified discovery calls for our sales team.

Follow up with warm leads and past inquiries.

Maintain accurate records of every call, conversation, and appointment in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.



Performance Expectations

Specific targets will be set after your training, performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Average length of outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion



Equipment & Workspace

Reliable power setup with a UPS (uninterruptible power supply) to bridge short outages without dropping calls; backup power for longer interruptions is strongly preferred.

Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.



Compensation & Schedule

Salary: $5 USD per hour, part time

Performance bonus: $50 USD for each qualified appointment that turns into a closed sale.

Hours: Monday to Friday, U.S. 10 AM to 2 PM EST / 10 PM to 2 AM PHT

Remote position



IMPORTANT

This role requires strong, reliable internet and clear and neutral English communication with little to no noticeable non-American accent. When you apply, enter the code word ARTESIAN in the form.

If you are unable to fit this criteria, please do not apply.



Apply Here:


/outbound



Applications submitted via this website will NOT be considered, please use the link above.

title: Executive Assistant + Canva Designer (Night Shift, Part-Time)
description:
ABOUT US

Soltera Roofing & Renovation is a roofing and construction company in Maryland, USA. We have completed over 1,000 roofing projects and hold a 5.0 Google rating. We are growing fast and run on clear systems, not chaos. You would join a team that already includes several team members in the Philippines.



THE ROLE

You will be the Executive Assistant to our CEO, Keiron. Your job is to keep his tasks organized, his calendar clean, and his projects moving. You will also design print marketing materials in Canva: mailers, postcards, flyers, and door hangers.



This is NOT a social media role. No video editing.



SCHEDULE

- Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day

- 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time (8:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Eastern)

- From mid-March, the shift moves to 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine time because of US daylight saving

- You must be online and responsive during your shift



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Send a short Daily Brief at the start of every shift: today's meetings, top priorities, and decisions needed

2. Organize and track tasks in Notion

3. Manage the CEO's Google Calendar: scheduling, rescheduling, meeting prep

4. Build Google Sheets and documents: trackers, research, comparisons

5. Design print materials in Canva using our brand kit

6. Follow up on open items so nothing gets forgotten

7. Write simple step-by-step guides (SOPs) for tasks you do often

8. Send an End of Day report at the end of every shift



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)

1. Strong Canva skills for PRINT design (mailers, postcards, flyers). Portfolio required.

2. Excellent written English

3. Experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant

4. Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs)

5. Reliable internet

6. Available for the night shift long-term



NICE TO HAVE

- Notion experience

- Experience with US-based companies

- Experience with construction, real estate, or home services



PAY

- $400/month for the first 30 days

- $100 bonus for completing 5 mailer templates in your first 30 days

- $480/month after 30 days

- $520/month after 90 days

- 13th month pay



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that do not follow these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Include a link to your Canva portfolio with at least 3 PRINT pieces you designed (flyers, postcards, mailers, or door hangers)

2. Answer these 3 questions in your message:

   a. Tell us about your most recent Executive Assistant or VA role. What were your main responsibilities?

   b. Your manager sends you 10 tasks on a Monday morning. How do you d
 what to do first?

   c. Have you worked a night shift before? For how long?



Qualified applicants will be invited to a short paid test.

title: Follow Up Specialist / Cold Caller — US Real Estate | 40 hrs | $6–8/hr
description:
Rise Home Buyers is a real estate investment company in New Jersey. We buy houses directly from owners - foreclosures, inherited properties, and off-market deals across New Jersey.



We're hiring TWO Follow Up Specialists to join our acquisitions team long-term. These are stable seats, not trial gigs. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Follow our script, find out whether they'd consider selling

- Handle objections and keep the conversation going

- Gather property details and set qualified appointments for our closers

- Log every call accurately in our CRM



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 1 year of outbound calling experience (real estate preferred, not required)

- Clear, confident spoken English - homeowners need to understand you easily.

- Noise-cancelling headset and a quiet place to work

- Reliable high-speed internet and power

- Able to take rejection all day and keep your energy up



PAY



- $6-$8 USD per hour depending on experience

- 40 paid hours per week +paid break.

- Commission on closed deals AND booked appointments.

- Paid weekly.

- Performance review and raise consideration at 90 days



SCHEDULE

Tue-Fri, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM US Eastern

Saturday, 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM US Eastern

OFF Sunday and Monday



Position 2

Mon-Thu, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM US Eastern

Sunday, 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM US Eastern

OFF Friday and Saturday



Please only apply if one of these shifts work for you you long-term.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read!

2. In your application please send us a VOICE RECORDING (1-2 minutes) along with a copy of your CV.

3. Follow this script for the voice recording: 



Introduce yourself

Tell us about your cold calling experience

Read this line as if you were on a real call: "Hi, is this Mr.

Johnson? My name is ___ and I'm calling about your property on Main Street - do you have thirty seconds?"





Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Look forward to chatting with you soon!

description:

--



JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills

• High preference: applicants within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER - FULL-TIME REMOTE | (Creative Content & Graphic Design Focus)
description:
Job Overview



We're looking for a highly creative, design-driven Social Media Manager to join our growing e-commerce team!



This role is ideal for someone with a strong eye for aesthetics, exceptional graphic design skills, and a natural ability to turn creative ideas into visually stunning, engaging social media content.



We're not just looking for someone who can schedule posts or manage social media accounts. We're looking for a creative thinker who can bring fresh ideas to life, create scroll-stopping visuals, and tell compelling stories through design.



The ideal candidate understands visual composition, typography, color combinations, branding, and what makes content stand out in a crowded social media feed.



While experience in social media strategy and analytics is valuable, our biggest priority is finding someone with genuine creativity, strong design fundamentals, and the ability to independently produce original, high-quality content.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Design & Content Creation (Primary Focus)

- Design high-quality, visually appealing graphics for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other social media platforms.

- Develop original creative concepts, promotional graphics, carousels, and visually engaging marketing materials.

- Create content that reflects the brand's personality, aesthetics, and visual identity.

- Develop fresh, creative ideas that capture attention and encourage audience engagement.

- Apply strong design principles, including typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.

- Transform product information and marketing campaigns into compelling visual stories.

- Maintain consistent branding while introducing fresh creative approaches.



Social Media Management (Secondary Focus)

- Plan and organize social media content calendars.

- Write engaging captions, hooks, and calls to action.

- Research emerging trends and identify opportunities for creative content.

- Schedule and publish content across social media platforms.

- Monitor engagement and recommend content improvements.

- Collaborate with the team on marketing campaigns, promotions, and product launches.

- Assist with community engagement and occasional customer support tasks when needed.



Qualifications & Requirements

*We're particularly interested in applicants who have:*

- Excellent graphic design skills and a strong understanding of aesthetics, typography, color combinations, and visual composition.

- A creative mindset with the ability to independently generate fresh, original content ideas.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating personally created social media graphics, promotional materials, or creative campaigns.

- Experience using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or similar graphic design tools.

- The ability to create visually compelling content that looks professional and consistent with a brand's identity.

- A good understanding of Instagram,
, TikTok, and current social media content formats.

- Strong written English skills for captions, creative hooks, and marketing content.

- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to deliver polished work.

- Good organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

- A proactive, self-motivated attitude and the ability to work independently.

- Availability to work full-time with hours overlapping US business hours.



Bonus Skills

- Experience editing short-form videos, Reels, or TikTok content.

- Experience creating content for e-commerce or US-based consumer brands.

- Experience developing creative campaigns that have generated strong organic engagement.

- Knowledge of social media analytics and content performance.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools.



Important: AI tools are welcome as part of your creative workflow. However, we're primarily looking for someone with genuine design skills, original ideas, and strong creative judgment. AI should enhance your creativity, not replace it.



Job Details

Employment Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Must be available for working hours overlapping US business hours.

Starting Rate:$5/hour for the first month, increasing to $6/hour after the first month, subject to satisfactory performance.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Updated Resume/CV

Highlight your relevant experience in graphic design, social media content creation, and social media management.



2. Creative Portfolio (Required)

Share at least **3–5 examples of your best original designs, preferably including:

- Instagram or
 graphics.

- Promotional or advertising creatives.

- Social media carousels.

- Creative campaigns or branded content.

We want to see work you've personally designed, not just social media accounts you've managed.



3. Previous Work Experience

If available, include links to social media accounts or brands you've worked with, along with a brief explanation of your responsibilities.



4. Brief Introduction

Tell us about your creative approach, what inspires your designs, and what makes your content stand out.



Our Hiring Process

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short creative assessment focused primarily on graphic design, originality, and content ideation.

This will help us better understand your creative style and how you approach real social media design tasks.



What We're Looking For

We value creativity, originality, and strong visual storytelling above simply knowing how to operate social media tools.

We're looking for someone who can take a basic product or campaign idea and transform it into something visually engaging, memorable, and aligned with the brand.



If you have a great eye for design, love creating beautiful content, and enjoy bringing fresh ideas to life, we'd love to see your work!



Applications with strong creative portfolios demonstrating original work, excellent design fundamentals, and a distinctive visual style will be prioritized.

title: PA and Office Administrator - Fully Remote (London Property Lettings)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION



We are a London-based property business managing a portfolio of around 25 long-term rental properties across the city. We are a small, hands-on team and this role is central to keeping the day-to-day running smoothly.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Assisting with the day-to-day administration of a portfolio of ~25 long-term rental properties in London.

* Reporting directly to the owner/director.

* Acting as the first point of contact for tenants: responding to enquiries, logging issues and following them through to resolution.

* Coordinating maintenance and repairs: taking tenant reports, getting quotes, booking contractors with our local London team and confirming work is completed.

* Tracking compliance documents and expiry dates (gas safety certificates, EICR, EPC, deposit protection, licences) and flagging renewals in good time.

* Coordinating property inspections three times a year with the local team, ensuring photographs are received and organised.

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping: logging rent payments, chasing arrears, and keeping expense records up to date.

* Maintaining and updating diary entries, files and property records.

* Occasionally helping outside normal working hours if there is an emergency.

* This description is an outline and is not intended to list all duties and responsibilities. It is subject to change based on the needs of the business.



ABOUT YOU



* Flexible approach.

* Quick, creative thinker.

* Great attention to detail.

* Polite and approachable manner.



REQUIREMENTS



* A minimum of 2 years' experience in an administrative or personal assistant role is essential.

* Experience in property lettings is required for this role.

* Comfortable taking on new tasks and learning new skills, with the ability to think on your feet, work independently, be proactive and remain self-motivated.

* Ability to work well under pressure.

* Competent, reliable, highly organised and efficient.

* Excellent IT skills, including good knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Word and Excel, and experience managing diaries.

* Experience using a lettings or property management database would be beneficial but is not essential.

* Ability to communicate and correspond clearly and accurately in English, both verbally and in writing.

* Honesty, integrity and care for the needs of the business.

* Ability to work on your own initiative and take responsibility for daily administrative operations.

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable workspace for remote working.

* Ability to work UK working hours from abroad.



HOURS AND WORKING MODEL



Normal working hours are 9am-5pm, Monday to Friday, plus a half-day on Saturdays. All working hours follow UK local time, including seasonal clock changes.



This is a fully remote role. There is no requirement to attend an office or visit properties in person.



Occasionally, overtime may be required during busy periods, which may mean finishing later than normal working hours.



SALARY



$600 USD per month.



Probationary period: 3 months.



Salary review: After completion of the probationary period.



EXPECTED START DATE



Ideally within 2 weeks.



Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: Fully remote, from abroad

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time





How to apply:



- Start your message with the words “Organic Growth”, so we know you read this ad.

- Record a Loom video (max 10 minutes) auditing 
. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

- Share one case study with real numbers: what the situation was, what you did, and what happened to traffic and leads and how long it took.

- In 2–3 sentences, explain how you’d earn high-quality links for a finance company without buying them.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.





If you’re a good fit, we’ll setup a Zoom interview to see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: BRAND GROWTH MANAGER & CREATIVE DIRECTOR
description:
# NOW HIRING: BRAND GROWTH MANAGER & CREATIVE DIRECTOR



**Bond Baby | Beauty & Hair Styling Brand**



**Social Media • Influencer Marketing • E-Commerce • Wholesale • Product Development**



**Long-Term Opportunity | Remote Position | Paid Trial Available**



## ABOUT BOND BABY



Hi, my name is Khairy Fiala, and I'm the founder of Bond Baby, a beauty brand specializing in lace adhesives and hair styling products.



Website: 
  


  





Bond Baby currently sells products through our website and wholesale distribution channels.



Our main hero product is our **Bond Baby Lace Glue**, but we also have additional products and plans to expand into new categories.



We believe the brand has significant growth potential. However, due to our involvement in other businesses, we haven't been able to dedicate the time, attention, or resources necessary to properly scale it.



The brand is currently operating at a relatively low level of activity, and we're looking for someone who can help us change that.



**We're not looking for someone who simply posts on Instagram. We're looking for someone who can help us manage, develop, and grow the brand.**



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want a creative, organized, ambitious, and proactive individual who can take responsibility for developing Bond Baby's marketing presence and helping us execute a long-term growth strategy.



Ideally, this person would act as a combination of:



- Brand Manager

- Social Media Strategist

- Creative Director

- Influencer & UGC Coordinator

- E-Commerce Marketing Specialist

- Wholesale Marketing Coordinator

- Product Development Researcher



You don't necessarily need to personally perform every task, but you should be capable of organizing, managing, and coordinating the work required to grow the business.



## 1. SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT & CONTENT STRATEGY



We want to rebuild and strengthen our presence on Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.



Responsibilities include:



- Developing a consistent content strategy

- Creating weekly and monthly content calendars

- Planning Instagram Reels and TikTok videos

- Developing engaging content concepts

- Writing scripts for product demonstrations

- Coordinating video editing and graphic design

- Improving our social media branding and aesthetics

- Researching trends within the beauty and hairstyling industry

- Monitoring engagement and content performance

- Identifying opportunities to increase brand awareness and sales



We're particularly interested in authentic content featuring real hairstylists, wig installers, and beauty professionals using our products.



**We are not interested in relying on generic AI-generated videos.**



We want real demonstrations, creative marketing, and content that builds trust in our products.



## 2. INFLUENCER, COLLABORATOR & UGC MANAGEMENT



This will be one of the most important weekly responsibilities.



We want someone who can actively recruit, communicate with, and manage content creators who specialize in wigs, lace installations, hairstyling, and beauty.



Responsibilities include:



- Finding relevant influencers and content creators

- Contacting potential collaborators

- Negotiating gifted and paid collaborations

- Coordinating product shipments

- Providing creative briefs and content instructions

- Following up on content deadlines

- Collecting and organizing completed videos

- Ensuring we have permission to reuse content

- Tracking collaboration performance

- Maintaining ongoing relationships with successful creators



Our goal is to consistently generate high-quality content without requiring our management team to personally coordinate every collaboration.



## 3. ORDER COORDINATION & FULFILLMENT COMMUNICATION



We currently handle online and wholesale orders internally.



Our standard shipping days are:



**Monday and Saturday**



However, we're flexible and open to adjusting this schedule if a more efficient fulfillment process is recommended.



We want someone who can:



- Coordinate with our team regarding incoming orders

- Track which influencer and customer orders need fulfillment

- Organize product shipments for collaborators

- Communicate shipping priorities

- Follow up on delayed or outstanding orders

- Help improve our order management workflow



Our internal team will continue handling physical fulfillment, but we want someone who can help coordinate and organize the process.



## 4. CREATIVE DIRECTION & BRANDING



We're looking for someone with a strong creative vision.



We want Bond Baby to develop a recognizable identity that stands out in the professional hair and beauty industry.



Responsibilities may include:



- Improving our Instagram and TikTok presentation

- Developing consistent brand aesthetics

- Designing or coordinating promotional flyers

- Creating product launch graphics

- Developing advertising concepts

- Improving product photography and presentation

- Coordinating website graphics and promotional banners

- Creating branded content templates

- Developing marketing campaigns around our hero products



We want someone who can look at our current branding and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.



## 5. E-COMMERCE & WEBSITE GROWTH



Our website is 
.



We want someone who can help improve our online sales performance through better marketing, presentation, and customer engagement.



Potential responsibilities include:



- Reviewing our website and identifying improvements

- Developing promotional campaigns

- Improving product presentation

- Coordinating content for product pages

- Recommending conversion improvements

- Exploring
 and SMS marketing opportunities

- Developing customer retention strategies

- Helping connect social media content with online sales



We're interested in building a more consistent and profitable online sales channel.



## 6. WHOLESALE GROWTH & BRAND PRESENCE



Bond Baby also sells products through wholesale channels.



We understand that some successful beauty brands may not have the strongest social media presence but still perform extremely well through beauty supply stores and professional distributors.



We want to strengthen both sides of our business.



This may include:



- Developing marketing materials for wholesale buyers

- Creating professional product catalogs

- Improving wholesale product presentations

- Identifying potential beauty supply distributors

- Developing promotional campaigns for retailers

- Coordinating outreach to potential wholesale accounts

- Building brand recognition among hairstylists and beauty supply businesses



Our goal is to increase demand from both individual consumers and wholesale customers.



## 7. PRODUCT EXPANSION & MANUFACTURER RESEARCH



Our primary product is Bond Baby Lace Glue.



However, we're interested in expanding into additional product categories, potentially including products manufactured in the United States.



We're particularly interested in:



**Lace Adhesives**



Competitor references:

- Erica J

- Bold Hold



**Braiding Mousse**



Product references:

- Lottabody Mousse

- Vigorol Mousse



**Braiding Gels**



Product references:

- AllDay Locks

- Loc N Gel



**Edge Control**



Product references:

- Bask & Lather

- Pure Edge Control



These brands are references for understanding product categories, positioning, customer demand, and competition.



We're not looking to copy their branding or proprietary formulas.



We want to develop our own products that compete through quality, branding, pricing, and distribution.



We'd like someone who can help:



- Research potential product opportunities

- Identify manufacturers and private-label suppliers

- Explore U.S.-based manufacturing options

- Compare manufacturing costs and minimum order quantities

- Coordinate sample requests

- Research competitors and market positioning

- Help organize product development projects

- Support new product launches



Experience with beauty product sourcing or private-label manufacturing would be a significant advantage.



## 8. WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES & REPORTING



We're extremely busy managing other businesses, so organization and independent execution are essential.



We want someone who can establish a weekly workflow and keep us informed without requiring constant supervision.



A typical week may involve:



- Recruiting and communicating with content creators

- Coordinating influencer product shipments

- Managing the social media content calendar

- Reviewing and approving content for publication

- Creating or coordinating promotional materials

- Monitoring website and social media performance

- Following up on wholesale opportunities

- Researching new products and manufacturers

- Communicating with our fulfillment team

- Providing a weekly progress report



We want clear communication about what's been completed, what's in progress, what needs our approval, and what opportunities you've identified.



## 9. PAID TRIAL OPPORTUNITY



Before committing to a long-term working relationship, we're interested in starting with a paid trial.



**We want to see what you can specifically do for Bond Baby.**



We're not particularly interested in reviewing dozens of unrelated portfolio examples.



We would prefer someone who takes the initiative to research our website, Instagram, TikTok, products, and competitors.



For the paid trial, we'd like you to propose a customized project that demonstrates your ability to improve our brand.



Potential trial deliverables include:



1. A review of our current website and social media presence.

2. A proposed 30-day content and marketing strategy.

3. Five original content ideas with scripts or creative briefs.

4. Two or three sample promotional graphics.

5. A proposed influencer collaboration strategy.

6. A list of potential content creators relevant to our products.

7. Recommendations for improving our online and wholesale sales.

8. A brief analysis of potential new product opportunities.



We're open to discussing the scope and pricing before work begins.



**We want customized, actionable work, not generic marketing advice.**



## 10. LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



If we're impressed with your trial, we'd like to discuss an ongoing role managing Bond Baby's creative direction, marketing activities, collaborator relationships, and growth initiatives.



We want someone who can become an important part of the business and help build the systems necessary to scale.



We're open to discussing different compensation structures based on experience, responsibilities, and results.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



We're looking for someone who:



- Has experience with beauty or hair care brands

- Understands Instagram and TikTok marketing

- Has experience coordinating influencers and UGC creators

- Understands e-commerce and online sales

- Can develop creative marketing campaigns

- Has strong organizational and communication skills

- Can manage multiple projects independently

- Understands wholesale or retail distribution

- Can research new products and manufacturers

- Is proactive and results-oriented



**Most importantly, we want someone who can take initiative and make meaningful progress without needing constant direction.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please review our brand before contacting us.



Website: 
  


  





When reaching out, please include:



1. What you believe Bond Baby could improve immediately.

2. Your proposed approach to growing the brand.

3. Your experience managing beauty brands or similar businesses.

4. Your pricing for an initial paid trial.

5. Your pricing for ongoing management.

6. Your availability and expected weekly commitment.

7. One original idea you would implement for Bond Baby.



**Please don't send only a generic portfolio or copy-and-paste introduction.**



We're looking for someone who genuinely researches our brand and demonstrates that they understand our goals.



## CONTACT INFORMATION



**Brand:** Bond Baby  

**Website:** 
  


  


  



**Contact:** Khairy Fiala  

**Phone/WhatsApp:** 
**Country Code:** +1 (United States)



We're open to working with qualified professionals internationally.



## FINAL NOTE



Bond Baby already has products, an established brand identity, an e-commerce website, and wholesale distribution opportunities.



**What we're missing is consistent execution, creative direction, and someone dedicated to helping the brand grow.**



We're looking for someone who sees the opportunity, takes ownership of their responsibilities, brings creative ideas, and helps us turn Bond Baby into a stronger and more recognizable beauty brand.



We don't want someone who simply tells us what they could do.



**We want someone who shows us what they would do specifically for Bond Baby and has the ability to execute it.**



Thank you!

title: Welcome to K-POP Universe: K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)
description:
- Recruitment validity period: Until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement

- A PH VA team of more than 5 people has already been formed, and business collaboration is possible using Tagalog in a comfortable atmosphere.

- Providing educational tutorial videos and operating a mentorship program to help new comers quickly adapt



[About Us]

Company Introduction (Video):

youtu.be/dO2mWWZANx8



At Summitree, we are building a global K-POP e-commerce business with a multicultural team from Korea, the Philippines, Mongolia, and other countries.

Our Filipino team members are an important part of our global growth. By joining Summitree, you will become part of an international team working together to grow HiDuckoo into a global K-POP brand.



[Who We Are Looking For]

K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)

We are not looking for a Video Editor who only edits footage provided by others.

We are looking for someone who genuinely loves K-POP and can take ownership of the entire content creation process:



**Trend Research → Idea Generation → Scriptwriting → B-roll Research → Shooting → Video Editing**



You will create both short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long-form content for YouTube.

Your goal is to create engaging content that attracts new audiences, grows the HiDuckoo brand, and ultimately contributes to sales.



[Responsibilities]

1. K-POP Content Planning

Follow current K-POP trends, including new artists, comebacks, fandom topics, memes, albums, merchandise, and social media trends, and turn them into engaging content ideas.

You should be able to independently research a topic, develop an idea, write a script, and plan the necessary B-roll.

2. HiDuckoo Behind-the-Scenes Content

Create interesting content from our actual e-commerce operations, including:

- Purchasing and receiving K-POP albums and merchandise

- New product arrivals

- Order processing

- Packing and shipping

- Warehouse and day-to-day operations

- HiDuckoo team behind-the-scenes

You should be able to turn ordinary business activities into content K-POP fans will enjoy watching.

3. Video Editing

Create and edit:

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok videos

- YouTube Shorts

- YouTube long-form videos

Use B-roll, subtitles, music, sound effects, transitions, hooks, storytelling, and pacing to create engaging videos that keep viewers watching.

4. On-Camera Content

For some content (refer to our 
 you will film yourself and appear on camera.

You do not need to appear in every video, but you must be comfortable speaking to viewers and having your face publicly featured on the company's social media channels.



[Required Qualifications]

- Strong video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

- Ability to edit both short-form and long-form content

- Strong interest in K-POP and active understanding of current trends

- Ability to independently research and plan content

- Ability to research and use appropriate B-roll

- Comfortable filming yourself and appearing on camera



[Preferred Qualifications]

- Experience creating K-POP or social media content

- Experience running a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or K-POP fan account

- Understanding of hooks, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with Photoshop or Canva

- Experience in social media marketing or e-commerce

- Experience creating product or behind-the-scenes content

- Experience using AI tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar tools in a content creation workflow



[Compensation & Benefits]

*Probationary Period: 6 Months

- Months 0–3: USD 250/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance

The probationary period may be shortened for excellent performance.

*After Regularization:

- Base Salary: USD 300/month

- Guaranteed 13th Month Pay

- One-year contract renewal basis

- Performance-based incentives and salary increases

*Performance & Salary Growth

Content performance matters. Meaningful growth in social media followers and/or sales on the HiDuckoo online shopping mall will be considered for performance incentives and salary increases.

Outstanding results may lead to an earlier salary increase.

*Benefits

- 10 additional paid leave days after regularization

- One K-POP album from your favorite artist on your birthday after six months of employment

- Paid holidays on January 1st and Christmas Day

- Opportunity to work with an existing Filipino team of 5+ members

*Long Service Incentive

- 1 Year: PHP 17,000

- 3 Years: PHP 22,500

- 5 Years: PHP 28,000



[How to Apply]

Please complete our Google Form application:






Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via
 or
 Messenger for a Google Meet interview.



If you run your own TikTok, Instagram, YouTube channel, or K-POP fan account, you are welcome to include it in your application.



Thank you.

Summitree

title: Part-Time Operations Assistant — Social Media & Outreach Support (Remote)
description:
Who we are



RenderVibe (
) is a small, founder-led software business. Our product turns ordinary real-estate listing photos into professionally staged renders, and we sell to realtors, brokerages, home stagers, photographers, and builders in the US and Canada. We are a small team, we work from written playbooks, and we are hiring one part-time operations assistant.



The job



You will run daily operations for our social media accounts and support our sales outreach. The work is precise, repetitive, and important. Everything is done from written instructions — your job is to follow them exactly, report exactly what happened, and flag problems the moment you see them.



Your duties:



- Set up, warm up, and operate social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok,
, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube) for a set of content personas, following a written playbook step by step

- Post approved content on schedule and log every action with live links

- Research real-estate businesses online and record their publicly published business contact details — accurately, with the source page for every detail

- Send outreach messages using word-for-word scripts we provide (you personalize only the parts the script marks)

- Keep a tracking sheet perfectly up to date: every account, every post, every message, every reply

- Send a written end-of-day report every working day, in our format, with live links — including days when the numbers are zero



What we need from you



- You follow written instructions exactly. If a script says send these words, you send these words. If a step can't be done as written, you flag it immediately and keep working on everything else — you never silently improvise and you never quietly skip it.

- You are honest about numbers. If you did 18, you report 18. If something you did doesn't match what you reported, you say so in the same report.

- You never guess contact details. If a business has not published an
 address, you write "none" and move on. A blank is always better than a guess here.

- You report daily, with links. "Done" is not a report. A link that can be clicked and checked is a report.

- Strong written English. You will send messages to North American businesses in the founder's name.

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and comfort with spreadsheets, Google Drive, and learning new tools (we will train you on our systems).

- Social media account management experience is a plus. Real-estate familiarity is a plus. Neither is required — precision and honesty are required.

- Sales or outreach experience is a strong plus — cold outreach, lead generation, appointment-setting, or follow-up work for a business. It carries a higher starting rate (see below). Describe it in Question 8.



Hours and pay



- Approximately 20 hours per week, remote, Philippines-based

- Work is mostly async, but some posting and reply windows are tied to North American business hours — say in your application which hours you can genuinely cover

- Rate: $6 per hour, paid via Wise. Candidates with proven sales or outreach experience start at $8 per hour.

- Start: the selected candidate starts in the second half of October 2026; the exact start date will be confirmed during selection



How to apply — read this carefully



Answer ALL of the screening questions below, in your application. Applications that skip any question will be ignored — this is the first test of the exact skill this job runs on.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid trial task (about 2–3 hours, paid via Wise on completion) before any offer is made. The trial uses real samples of this job's actual work. We hire from the trial results, not from interviews alone.



Screening questions:



1. Start your answer to this question with the exact words "I read it all:" — then tell us, in two or three sentences, about the most repetitive, detail-heavy task you have done for a client or employer.

2. A task in your written instructions cannot be done exactly as written — for example, a link is broken or a step is impossible on the platform. Walk us through exactly what you would do, in order.

3. You need a business's contact
. Their website has a contact form but no
 address published anywhere, and no
 on their social profiles either. What do you do? List what you would do and what you would not do.

4. Your end-of-day report says you sent 20 messages, but your breakdown by category adds up to 18. You notice this after sending the report. What do you do?

5. Rewrite this messy note as a clean 3-line status update: "so today i did the warmup for vanessa and sofia ig and tiktok, dre ig only because fb login problem again, posted vanessa reel, will fix fb tomorrow maybe."

6. Which social platforms have you personally managed accounts on, and what happened the last time an account you managed got restricted, flagged, or locked? (If it has never happened, say so.)

7. Which hours can you actually work each week (Philippine time), and what other jobs or commitments do you currently have?

8. Describe any sales, outreach, or appointment-setting experience you have: what you sold or promoted, who you reached out to, roughly how many outreaches you handled in a typical week, and what results you got. If you have none, say so plainly — honesty here counts for more than experience.

title: AU Senior Accountant / Team Leader
description:
About Us



From SMEs and start-ups to large corporates, high-net-worth individuals, and self-managed super funds, our team has the depth and flexibility to meet diverse needs. We work alongside a strong network of legal, finance, and banking partners to ensure you're supported at every stage of your journey.



Job Summary



The Senior Accountant works independently to complete standard accounting and tax engagements with minimal supervision, while also providing support to other team members. The candidate manages their own workload; self-reviews output for quality and communicates proactively with the onshore team.



Why Join Us



Salary from PHP110,000 to 190,000 per month (depending on experience)

Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth

Supportive and collaborative work environment

Access to ongoing training

Friendly working environment

Permanent work-from-home set-up

New equipment supplied



The Role



We're growing, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Accountant with a strong grasp of Australian taxation to join our team.



If you know Australian tax inside out and take pride in accuracy, this role was made for you.



Roles and Responsibilities



Independently process electronic data and journal entries across all client sizes; prepare complete working papers and reconciliations with no guidance required.

Prepare and review financial statements, tax returns, BAS, FBT, and tax planning

Review returns for individuals, partnerships, trusts and companies

Ensure all client work is accurate, compliant, and meets Australian tax law requirements

Respond to client queries via
 or client portal under production manager oversight. Draft responses for production manager review on more complex matters.

Manage ATO client correspondence and queries

Attend to routine corporate secretarial requirements independently, including review of ASIC notifications, minutes, and resolutions.

Conduct tax research, stay updated on legislation, and anticipate changes

Prepare tax planning schedules and supporting analysis for manager/partner review



Why this role is for you



If you are an outgoing, confident communicator, love numbers, and are proactive, this role is perfect for you!



You have



At least 4 years of experience in Australian public practice accounting, with a focus on tax and financial statement preparation.

Solid understanding of accounting principles and tax compliance

Strong attention to detail and organisational skills

Solid interest in building efficiencies and not conforming to the status quo

Good communication skills - verbal and written – being confident to ask questions



Systems & Technology (desirable, but not essential)



You will be working with:

MYOB Accountants Enterprise

MYOB Practice Management System (MPM)

Nimbus Document Management System

MYOB Essentials and Account Right

Xero



Reasons to Join Us



Be part of a team with a fantastic, supportive culture
